title: 第23章 晋升正式弟子第24章 聚元八层
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏铭大步迈进外门任务堂。
心中那股兴奋劲儿，如同即将喷发的火山，都快按捺不住了。
他此刻手头攥着710个宗门贡献积分，远超晋升外门正式弟子所需的300积分。
“执事大人，我要晋升为外门正式弟子！”苏铭走到执事李韵舟面前，语气坚定，透着不容置疑的自信。
李韵舟抬眸，目光在苏铭身上扫了一圈，神色间带着几分审视。
这时，周围那些外门弟子听闻此话，瞬间炸开了锅。
“啥？这杂役弟子想晋升正式弟子？怕不是在白日做梦吧！”一个尖细的声音陡然响起。
“就是就是，一个杂役，怎么可能攒够三百积分，简直是痴心妄想！”另一个附和道，语气中满是不屑，还带着刺耳的嘲笑。
这些家伙，平日里就仗着自己是外门弟子，对外门杂役百般看不起。
巧了，纪红衫竟也在任务堂。
那身姿，简直火辣到爆，胸前规模堪称“雄伟壮观”。一袭红色罗裙，将她的曼妙身段勾勒得淋漓尽致，一举一动间，风情万种尽显。
此刻，她目光触及苏铭的瞬间，惊喜刹那间点亮了双眸。
“苏师弟！”她热情呼喊，声音清脆得如同黄莺出谷，直钻人心，“上次可多亏了你救我，不然呐，我怕早就葬身妖兽之口啦！”
“我就说你咋这么厉害，竟然以杂役弟子的身份，积攒了这么多的积分！”
这纪红衫，那可是外门顶流大美女啊！
追求者那叫一个多，跟下饺子似的，乌央乌央全是。
平日里，她的心就跟被超级无敌护盾罩着似的，谁都甭想让她心动半分。
可眼下呢，她竟对苏铭这般热络。
“我没眼花吧？纪师姐咋对那苏铭这么热情！”有弟子瞪大了眼睛，满是不可置信，声音都拔高了八度。
“就是啊，纪师姐向来冷若冰霜，对咱们都爱答不理的，苏铭何德何能！”另一弟子满脸的羡慕嫉妒恨，牙齿咬得咯咯响。

“哼，指不定苏铭使了什么见不得人的手段，把纪师姐给迷惑了！”又有弟子满脸阴沉，语气里满是恶意。
周围一众弟子，眼睛都瞪得像铜铃，满满的全是羡慕嫉妒恨，那目光，仿佛要把苏铭千刀万剐。
苏铭表面神色平静，只是轻轻点头回应。
“好巧，又遇见了。”
话虽如此说，但苏铭脑海之中，却不受控制地浮现出纪红衫那傲然挺立、曲线玲珑的身材，怎么都挥之不去。
这身材，着实有些犯规了啊，让他心里也泛起了些许异样的波澜。
苏铭收敛心神，大步上前，将自己的积分递到执事李韵舟面前。
李韵舟目光一扫，顿时瞪大了眼睛，满脸不可思议，失声惊呼：“七百个积分！你竟攒了七百个积分才来晋升？”
他心中暗自惊叹，深知杂役弟子积攒积分的难度，那简直是难于登天。这般数量的积分，对于杂役弟子而言，几乎是不可能完成的任务。
“你早该来了啊！”李韵舟忍不住又道，语气中满是感慨。
content_en:
Su Ming strode into the outer mission hall.
The excitement in my heart was like a volcano about to erupt, and I could hardly contain it.
He currently holds 710 sect contribution points, far exceeding the 300 points required to be promoted to a formal disciple of the outer sect.
"Sir Deacon, I want to be promoted to an official disciple of the outer sect!" Su Ming walked up to Deacon Li Yunzhou, his tone was firm, revealing unquestionable confidence.
Li Yunzhou raised his eyes and scanned Su Ming's body with a somewhat scrutinizing expression.
At this time, when the surrounding outer disciples heard this, they immediately exploded.
"What? This handyman disciple wants to be promoted to a formal disciple? I'm afraid he's just daydreaming!" A high-pitched voice suddenly sounded.
"That's right, how can a handyman save three hundred points? It's simply wishful thinking!" Another echoed, his tone full of disdain and harsh ridicule.
These guys usually rely on themselves as outer disciples and look down on the outer disciples in every possible way.
By coincidence, Ji Hongshan was also in the mission hall.
That figure is so hot, and the size of her chest can be called "majestic". Wearing a red skirt, her graceful figure was vividly outlined, and every move showed her charm.
At this moment, the moment her eyes touched Su Ming, her eyes suddenly lit up with surprise.
"Junior Brother Su!" she shouted passionately, her voice as clear and clear as an oriole emerging from the valley, which penetrated people's hearts, "Thanks to you for saving me last time, otherwise, I would have been killed by a monster long ago!"
"I'm just wondering how you are so powerful. You have accumulated so many points as a handyman disciple!"
This Ji Hongshan is a top-notch beauty from the outer sect!
There are too many suitors, just like dumplings, Wuyang Wuyang is full of them.
On weekdays, her heart felt like it was covered by a super invincible shield, and no one wanted to make her heart beat even a little bit.
But right now, she was so warm to Su Ming.
"Am I not dazzled? Why is Senior Sister Ji so enthusiastic about Su Ming!" A disciple's eyes widened in disbelief, and his voice rose an octave.
"That's right, Senior Sister Ji has always been cold and indifferent to us all. How can Su Ming be so virtuous?" Another disciple's face was full of envy, jealousy and hatred, and his teeth gritted loudly.
"Hmph, maybe Su Ming used some shady means to confuse Senior Sister Ji!" Another disciple had a gloomy face and a tone full of malice.
The eyes of the disciples around him were as wide as bells, full of envy, jealousy, and hatred. Their gazes seemed to want to cut Su Ming into pieces with a thousand knives.
Su Ming looked calm on the surface and just nodded slightly in response.
"What a coincidence, we meet again."
Having said that, Ji Hongshan's proudly upright and curvaceous figure appeared uncontrollably in Su Ming's mind, and he couldn't get rid of it no matter what.
This figure was indeed a bit foul, which made him feel a little strange.
Su Ming gathered his thoughts, strode forward, and handed his points to Deacon Li Yunzhou.
Li Yunzhou's eyes widened as he glanced over, his face full of disbelief, and he exclaimed: "Seven hundred points! You actually saved 700 points to get promoted?"
He secretly marveled in his heart, knowing that it was extremely difficult for the handyman disciples to accumulate points. Such a number of points is an almost impossible task for the handyman disciples.
"You should have come a long time ago!" Li Yunzhou couldn't help but said again, his tone full of emotion.
